description: Managed device driver for the BZBGear BG-4K-VP44.
author: symetrix

notes: New standard panel: BZBGear header, stock Cognio controls.
Connect Offline replaces the Connect, Disconnect and AutoConnect buttons: online the driver always connects; offline it connects only while Connect Offline is on.
Connected lights only after the switcher accepts the login, a switcher that stops answering is dropped and retried, and Reboot is sent once and then reconnects.
